name: Open Text Corporation
research_rationale: Q1 cloud growth and unchanged FY guidance support the cash-flow value case, but segment execution gaps, heavy net debt and legacy filing risks still temper full alignment with a strong-buy screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
FQ1 2027 (reported 5 Nov): revenue about $1.24bn, full-year outlook unchanged; core cloud up ~11.7% but news summaries flag ITOM and cybersecurity execution weakness.  
Refreshed financials still show TTM free cash flow about $845m and net debt about $4.8bn; no new annual filing narrative in this batch.  
Later headlines are largely promotional or generic value commentary, with no fresh governance or accounting disclosures.
